# Solfegio

> Solfegio (RecogniseChord) is a Ukrainian and English web app for practicing music theory by ear. It helps users recognize chords and intervals, build chords, and learn intervals from familiar melodies.

The live site is hosted at https://solfegio.azurewebsites.net/.
The source repository is https://github.com/PianoMaker/RecogniseChord.

## Main pages

- [Chord and interval ear training](https://solfegio.azurewebsites.net/): Listen to generated chords with 2–5 notes and identify their type and quality.
- [Build a chord](https://solfegio.azurewebsites.net/Create): Explore chord construction by selecting notes and chord properties.
- [Intervals in familiar melodies](https://solfegio.azurewebsites.net/Melodies): Learn interval sounds through examples from Ukrainian and international melodies.
- [About the project](https://solfegio.azurewebsites.net/Privacy): Project information, features, and attempt statistics.

## Languages

The interface supports Ukrainian (default) and English. The language selector changes the interface language.

## Project source

- [README](https://github.com/PianoMaker/RecogniseChord/blob/master/README.md): Overview, setup, usage, and development notes.
- [Source code](https://github.com/PianoMaker/RecogniseChord): ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application targeting .NET 8.

The app generates and plays chords in the browser, renders musical notation, and includes utilities for audio and MIDI processing. It is an educational practice tool.
